spec.experiment: SG-combined-v2 one-sided coarse caps and fine-vs-hierarchy route diagnostic

cell_definitions.V1: ordinary raw 16->32->64 hierarchy (SG31 S2 / SG-combined-v1 C1)
cell_definitions.V2: SG-combined-v1 C6 replay: exact KL core at both transitions + unconditional fine completion
cell_definitions.V3: one-sided cap at 16->32 only, raw measure space
cell_definitions.V4: one-sided cap at 16->32 and 32->64, raw measure space
cell_definitions.V5: V3 core + unconditional fine completion (C6 completion convention)
cell_definitions.V6: V3 core + completion admitted where P1 >= B (G >= 1/2), whole positive residual

spec.cap: z_j = q_j * min(1, p_g / (mean_{k in g} q_k + eps)) on 2x2 groups; generalized-KL projection onto groupwise upper-mass constraints sum_g z <= 4 p_g in non-normalized measure space; clipped mass discarded, not redistributed; not a probability-simplex projection; no per-call renormalization
spec.ca: frozen A3 class-word W: SD1.5, selected eleven CA modules, calls 0-30, all heads
spec.sa: SG25/SG33 sources 16/32/64, matched calls 10-20 inclusive, eight heads; head-mean within each call for the hierarchy; V0 observation-wise fine P2
spec.completion: same-call head-mean fine SA on the min-max normalized core; SG32 first-pass selected-row background (threshold 0.5); positive residual only

route_diagnostic.score: R_I = sum_i B_i [F_i - H_i]_+ / (sum_i [F_i - H_i]_+ + 1e-8) on min-max normalized pre-CRF 64x64 maps; B = call-mean background support
route_diagnostic.target: 1[IoU(H+R2) > IoU(F+R2)] per image; VOC uses training-fold thresholds of each held-out fold, COCO uses full-VOC thresholds; ties excluded and counted
route_diagnostic.direction: higher R_I predicts H better; AUC is never flipped
route_diagnostic.go_no_go: a routed cell may be registered later only if ROC-AUC >= 0.65 on VOC OOF and on frozen COCO; its cutoff would then be chosen inside VOC training folds

spec.selection: five frozen VOC folds; raw and R2 screens separately versus same-generation V0; forced OOF, pairwise wins and selector reported separately; registered promotion guard; full-VOC thresholds frozen for COCO; no COCO tuning
spec.diagnostics: raw-map AP and best-threshold mIoU per cell (diagnostic only); cap binding fraction and removed-mass fraction per transition; fixed-0.45 TP/FP change accounting for V1->V3, V3->V4, V3->V5, V5->V6, V2->V5
spec.excluded: SG33 M2 coarse source (only as a separately registered add-on if C10 earns it); geometric soft conservation
spec.storage: resumable per-image confusion counts and compact diagnostics; no generated image, mask, dense map, QK or affinity cache

voc.diagnostic_note: GT enters diagnostics only; fixed 0.45 comparisons do not use cell-selected thresholds

coco.diagnostic_note: GT enters diagnostics only; fixed 0.45 comparisons do not use cell-selected thresholds
